query:
SELECT nc.newsId, nc.categoryId, c.nameAr, n.title 
FROM newsCategories nc 
JOIN categories c ON nc.categoryId = c.id 
JOIN news n ON nc.newsId = n.id 
ORDER BY nc.newsId DESC 
LIMIT 10;
